items.title: Mushoku Tensei Releases Old Rudeus' Full Diary From Light Novel Volume 15 After Season 3 Episode 13
items.summary: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation has released the full Old Rudeus diary following the release of Season 3 Episode 13.
